job.purpose: [smmv-b/smt] ot_hbm_accel_smh_tile_wg: SM tile as ONE ref_tile cluster (owner contract: harden once, step x16; wg = MY mirror) over the 12 closed ref_tile sub-tiles (pt_w p45h, pt_e p40s, xs p50, bdc p50, tcl p45, tct p45), floorplan re-derived from their LEFs on the 43.2-um lattice (630.72 x 1252.8, landing channels 58-60 um, cut 0.59), clock spine through the tile ICG, exact abutment pin plan. Five registered regional static-strap stages per leaf (260 DFFs), zero data latency; production NC8 active8 lockstep exactness plus strap-offset/late32/hold0 mutants must fail.

benches.name: lockstep_enreg_xlk
benches.cmd: W=$(mktemp -d /tmp/smtb.XXXXXX); python3 tools/dshbm_sm_pq_seq.py run --seq stress --nc 8 --active 8 --smh --cg --define OT_SMH_CG_ENREG --define OT_SMH_XLK --define OT_FP_DATA_NORST --define OT_SMH_DRST0 --define OT_SMH_RSTRELAY --define OT_SMH_HIER --define OT_SMH_PTW_OHDLY --cg-gap 300 --build-jobs 8 --workdir $W --out {RUN}/b_lockstep_enreg_xlk.json > {RUN}/b_lockstep_enreg_xlk.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {RUN}/b_lockstep_enreg_xlk.log | tail -5; grep -h CG_LOCKSTEP $W/*/runtime.log; test $rc -eq 0 && grep -q 'CG_LOCKSTEP mismatches 0 ' $W/*/runtime.log && echo SMT_LOCKSTEP_PASS
